purpose: Teach: 一体化/つとめ/マネージメント/結集/少人数/樹立/取り込ん/交互

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、創業時、現場と本社を一体化された
lines.en: When you were starting out, you unified the field operations and headquarters.
lines.style: Slow, measured cadence. Gentle gaze downward, then up at his son. Speaking as someone reviewing a lifetime of wisdom. Warm respect in the pauses between phrases.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは経営のおつとめを生涯果たされた
lines.en: Yes. He devoted his entire life to leading the company with integrity.
lines.style: Quiet certainty. Eyes steady and forward. Slight weight on 'entire life' — acknowledging the sacrifice. Not defensive, but claiming something true about the man he's remembering.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、社員へのマネージメント手腕が見事だった
lines.en: His instinct for managing people was remarkable.
lines.style: Soft voice, almost to himself. Slight smile at a memory. Trailing breath at the end, as if he can still see it. The wonder of watching someone do something brilliantly.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは社内の知恵を結集された
lines.en: Yes. He brought together the best thinking in the whole company.
lines.style: Reflective, not hurried. Speaking from deep understanding. Eyes slightly unfocused, turning inward. Each word deliberate, honoring the complexity of what his father built.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、少人数で起業された頃を懐かしむ
lines.en: Those early days, when you had just a small team starting from nothing — he missed that sometimes.
lines.style: Wistful, quieter now. Gentle nostalgia in the tone. Slight tremor of affection. Speaking as someone watching his son understand what was lost in the gain.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは新部署の樹立を主導された
lines.en: Yes. He drove the creation of new divisions, kept building.
lines.style: Affirming, grounded. Slight nod in the voice. Not sentimental — factual but warm. Honoring the work without explaining or justifying it.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、海外の知見を取り込んで経営された
lines.en: He would bring in ideas from overseas, always learning, always expanding the business.
lines.style: Admiring, almost marveling. Softer attack. The tone of someone watching ambition tempered by genuine curiosity. Slight breathiness on the trailing thought.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは現場と本社を交互に視察された
lines.en: Yes. He would travel between the field and the office, always watching, always connecting.
lines.style: Quiet close, almost a benediction. Slow, deliberate rhythm. Eyes distant but present. Final words settle like a conclusion — not ending the conversation, but resting on a truth that needs no more words.
